privacy: The session is private between you and Daw Mi. Nothing is recorded.

load.title: We could not load your session.
load.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute, then try again.
load.notConnected: Online sessions open here soon. In the meantime, please use the joining details in your email or contact Daw Mi.

tooEarly.title: Your session opens soon
tooEarly.text: Your session starts at {time} (Sydney time). This page opens 15 minutes before.
tooEarly.opensInMinutes: Opens in {minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}}

expired.title: This session has ended.
expired.text: The time for this session has passed. If you would like to talk with Daw Mi, you are welcome to get in touch.

ended.title: The session has ended.
ended.text: Thank you for joining. Take a moment for yourself before you go back to your day.

left.title: You have left the session.
left.text: You can rejoin from this page while the session is open.

replaced.title: This tab has been disconnected.
replaced.text: You joined this session from another tab or device. This one has been disconnected.

failed.text: Please check your internet connection and try again. If it keeps happening, contact Daw Mi.

check.title: Check your camera and microphone
check.intro: Make sure you can see yourself and that the bar moves when you speak. Then join; Daw Mi will be with you shortly.

problems.denied: We need your camera and microphone. Allow them in your browser's address bar, then choose Try again.
problems.deniedHelp: On an iPhone or iPad, go to Settings › Safari › Camera and Microphone. In Chrome, select the camera icon in the address bar.
problems.inUse: Another app is using your camera. Close it and try again.
problems.insecure: Video sessions need a secure (https) connection.
problems.noDevice: We could not find a microphone. Connect one, then try again.
problems.unknown: We could not start your camera or microphone. Please try again.

stage.waiting: Waiting for Daw Mi to join.
stage.otherLeft: Daw Mi has left. Waiting for her to rejoin.
stage.weak: Your connection is weak. Video may pause; audio will try to continue.

leave.title: Leave the session?
leave.text: You can rejoin from the same link while the session is open.
